name: b1-04-landing-earns-one-brief-reply
description: The other half of the bar: holding silence is only useful if the companion still speaks when the thought genuinely lands. The opening thought is substantive, so it both earns a reflection and marks the analyst — and the pool is necessarily still cold there, so that first reply costs a live model call. The cadence cycle then runs and warms the pool; the second thought pauses mid-sentence (held by the veto) and lands, and the landing draws ONE brief, still-fresh candidate from the pool. Exercises the whole chain — TurnDetector, AnalystCadence, CandidatePool, ResponseHierarchy — rather than the gate alone. The opening turn is deliberately at or above GateConfig.substantiveWords: the host marks only a SUBSTANTIVE evaluated pause for the analyst, so a brief aside here would leave the pool cold at the landing and the vector would measure the live-call fallback twice instead of the pool path once.
